mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservations ( user_id, facility_id, scheduled_at, request_message ) VALUES ( #{request.userId}, #{request.facilityId}, #{request.scheduledAt}, #{request.message} )
mapper.select:
SELECT r.id AS id, r.facility_id AS facilityId, f.name AS facilityName,
DATE_FORMAT( r.scheduled_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AS scheduledAt,
r.request_message AS message, r.status AS status,
DATE_FORMAT( r.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AS createdAt
FROM reservations r
INNER JOIN facilities f ON r.facility_id = f.id
WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status != 'CANCELED'
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.id AS id, r.facility_id AS facilityId, f.name AS facilityName, r.user_id AS userId, u.name AS userName, u.email AS userEmail,
DATE_FORMAT(r.scheduled_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS scheduledAt,
r.request_message AS message, r.status AS status,
DATE_FORMAT(r.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt
FROM reservations r INNER JOIN facilities f ON r.facility_id = f.id INNER JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id
AND r.status = #{status}
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations r
AND r.status = #{status}
